author: Dvniiz
quote: I've playe over 12 hours and from my perspective, GTA 6 is shaping up to be a disappointment considering how long we've been waiting for it. Honestly, I feel like the map doesn't offer anything truly innovative and looks more like a recycled version of Vice City than a real evolution of the franchise. The gameplay seems slow, clunky, and not particularly entertaining, while the excessive cinematics take away from what actually matters: playing the game and having fun. I also don't think the graphics and resolution live up to the massive expectations Rockstar has built over the years. I'm not saying the game is a complete failure, but I was expecting a revolution in gaming, not just another cinematic experience. To me, all those years of development should result in genuine innovation, not simply a more visually ambitious presentation.
